Where it often goes wrong with WordPress

Three things we regularly come across on WordPress websites. They are separate from NXEO, you can check them yourself today.

The tick box under Reading

Under Settings and then Reading there is a tick box that asks search engines to skip your site. It is switched on during the build and sometimes never switched off again.

Security that is too strict

Security plugins can keep out unknown visitors. In doing so you also shut out the search services AI systems lean on.

Text that only loads after a click

Some themes and builders only load text in tabs or collapsible blocks after a click. A system does not click and then sees an empty space.

Questions about NXEO and WordPress

Do I have to install anything myself?

We set up the connection with your WordPress website together during onboarding. We walk you through what is needed at that point. You do not need technical knowledge for it.

Does it work with my theme or page builder?

In most cases it does. The content arrives as an ordinary page or post in WordPress and takes on the styling of your theme. During onboarding we check whether there is anything unusual about your website.

Does anything go online without me knowing?

No. You see beforehand what is ready and you approve it. If you reject something, we replace it at no extra cost.

Can I edit the texts myself afterwards?

Yes. They are ordinary pages and posts in your WordPress. You open them like any other page and change what you like.

What happens to the content if I stop?

It stays. Everything we have created remains yours: the pages, the posts and your measurement data.
